CustomField.formula: CASE(MOD(DATEVALUE( LastModifiedDate ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 1, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 2 + 3, 2, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 2 + 3, 3, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 2 + 3, 4, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 2 + 3, 5, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 2 + 3, 6, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 1 + 3, DATEVALUE(LastModifiedDate) + 3 )
CustomField.label: Due Date System
